# Dayflow — Human Resource Management System
# Security Checklist Part B #11

> Dayflow digitizes core HR operations for small and medium businesses.

## What is Dayflow?

Dayflow is an internal HR management tool covering:
- Employee directory and profile management
- Attendance tracking (check-in/check-out, work hours)
- Leave/time-off request and approval workflows
- Salary structure and payroll visibility

## Access

Dayflow is an authenticated, internal tool. Public access is limited to the login page.
Employee accounts are created by Admin or HR Officers — there is no public self-registration.

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js + Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL
